source_text: Ecce tu pulchra es, amica mea; ecce tu pulchra es; oculi tui columbae. Iteratio pulchritudinis praesens et futurum significare potest: nunc speciosa imitatione Christi, tunc perfectione. Oculi columbae intelligentiam spiritalem denotant, quae a Spiritu sancto datur. Nisi oculos columbae acceperit anima, pulchritudinem Verbi perspicere non potest.
pass_a_gloss: Behold you fair are, friend my; behold you fair are; eyes your doves. Repetition of-beauty present and future to-signify can: now fair by-imitation of-Christ, then by-perfection...
pass_b_english: [[Behold, you are fair, my friend; behold, you are fair; your eyes are doves >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:15]]. The doubled beauty can mark present and future: now fair by imitation of Christ, then fair by perfection itself. Dove-eyes signify spiritual understanding given by the Holy Spirit. Unless the soul receives dove-eyes, she cannot perceive the Word’s beauty.
